messages:
Aisha Khan: Hi all — I accepted my org invite but GitHub is asking me to set up 2FA and I only have my phone's authenticator app on my old device. The SSO flow is stuck. Anyone have a quick workaround?
Ben Turner: Welcome Aisha! If the org requires 2FA you need to enable it on the account that accepted the invite. If you can't access your authenticator app you can use backup codes or add a new device. Did the invite land on a work email or a personal one?
Aisha Khan: Invite was to aisha@redwood.ai (work). I accepted on my laptop but my phone with the authenticator is being repaired. I still see "Pending SSO" in the org UI and can't clone private repos.
infra-bot: Automated note: Organization enforces SAML SSO and two-factor authentication. Users without 2FA will be blocked from org resources until 2FA is completed. Admins can revoke and resend invites if needed.
Ben Turner: Two quick options: 1) Use backup recovery codes (if you saved them when you first set up 2FA), or 2) temporarily enable SMS 2FA (GitHub supports SMS as backup) and then switch to authenticator later. If neither works, we can revoke and re-invite to a different account you control.
Aisha Khan: I don't have backup codes. Is SMS okay? I prefer authenticator but need access today.
Sam Miller: SMS is allowed but less secure — fine short-term. Go to GitHub -> Settings -> Security -> "Set up two-factor authentication" -> choose "SMS" and add your current phone number. After that, visit the org page and authorize SAML.
Aisha Khan: Followed the steps and set up SMS 2FA. The org page now shows "Member (SAML authorized)". Trying to clone now... I get 403 over HTTPS.
Ben Turner: Are you using a PAT or SSH? If you used HTTPS with a credential helper, it might still be presenting an old token from a different account. Try `git config --global credential.helper` to see what helper you're using, or try SSH: `git clone git@github.com:redwood-inference/roadmap.git`.
Aisha Khan: I used a PAT generated earlier on my personal account. I cleared the credential helper cache and created a PAT on aisha@redwood.ai with repo scope. Clone works now.
infra-bot: Reminder: Admins may rotate invites if the wrong account accepted, and will add new hires to teams after access is confirmed.
Sam Miller: Added Aisha to eng-product with write access. Quick security note: once your phone is repaired, switch from SMS to authenticator app (GitHub supports TOTP) and remove SMS. Also save recovery codes.
Aisha Khan: Done — switched to authenticator and saved recovery codes offline. Can confirm I can push and open private repos. Thanks for the guidance!
thread_body_preview: New hire couldn't complete 2FA (authenticator on broken phone), used SMS as temporary fix, created PAT on work account, authorized SAML, admin added to team, later switched to authenticator and saved recovery codes.
